html:
The Sanguine Set consists of the best equipment in the game released with the Summer Update 2023, having a minimum level requirement of 600. The set consists of a piece of equipment and weapons (one and two handed) for each vocation.

The items can be obtained from Bakragore, the final boss of the Rotten Blood Quest, as well as from the Crimson Offering system. They contain Sanguine Power Augments, and the weapons have a special version called Grand Sanguine, which has stronger effects of these augments.
